_comment: Frontier nonstop route map relevant to this trip, researched 2026-08-17 (press releases, news, schedule aggregators). Frontier's 2026 network is exceptionally volatile - re-verify every leg on flyfrontier.com before travel day.
freshnessWarning: Frontier exited 10 airports (Feb 2026), added 38 routes backfilling Spirit's collapse (Jul 2026), then cut 20+ routes in Q3 2026. Days of week are as-launched and shift seasonally. Confirm in the Frontier app before relying on any leg.

RIC-MCO.note: launched Apr 2026 as limited-time, still in schedule

LAS-IAD.note: daily since May 1, 2026 - best GoWild path back toward Virginia

routeNotes.RIC: Only DEN + MCO, both ~2x weekly (Thu/Sun). RIC-ATL ended May 2026.
routeNotes.ORF: ATL ~3x weekly + MCO. No DEN or LAS nonstop from ORF.
routeNotes.LAS: Bay Area + connection-relevant subset of ~37 LAS routes. No BWI/DCA/PHF. RDU and ORD unconfirmed for 2026 (excluded). OAK-DEN also reported but not PR-verified (excluded).
routeNotes.connections: Frontier only sells connections its system builds for published city pairs - never assume two GoWild segments combine; a misconnect on a 2x-weekly route can strand you for days. Prefer same-itinerary connections over self-built ones.
routeNotes.SFO: All SFO routes are western - going east on GoWild from SFO means connecting in DEN (or backtracking via LAS).
routeNotes.SFO-ORF: NO Frontier one-stop exists (SFO-MCO seasonal ended Aug 2026). Use SFO->DEN->RIC, go via LAS-IAD, or take another airline.
routeNotes.verify: Frontier only sells published connecting city pairs - confirm connectability for your exact dates on flyfrontier.com.
